block_size.description: Block size in 100k steps (default 9 = 900k). Corresponds to the -b flag.

compression_level.description: BWT block size / compression level from 1 (fast) to 9 (best). Corresponds to -1..-9 flags.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory usage in 1MB steps. Corresponds to the -m flag.

num_processors.description: Number of processors to use (0 or -1 for autodetect). Corresponds to the -p flag.

stdout_output.description: Output to standard out (stdout) instead of a file. Corresponds to the -c flag.

keep_input.description: Keep input file, do not delete after compression. Corresponds to the -k flag.

force_overwrite.description: Force overwrite existing output file. Corresponds to the -f flag.

quiet_mode.description: Quiet mode (suppress output). Corresponds to the -q flag.

verbose.description: Verbose mode. Corresponds to the -v flag.

load_average_control.description: Load average determines max number processors to use. Corresponds to the -l flag.

read_into_ram.description: Read entire input file into RAM and split between processors. Corresponds to the -r flag.
